deals.travelWindow: Sep 5, 12, 19 cheapest one-way base fares confirmed on Allegiant's own site; nonstop, 5x weekly
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $110-150 RT base fare nonstop, and Great Smoky Mountains National Park — the most-visited national park in the US — is a 45-minute drive away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown Knoxville's Market Square and the Old City are small and walkable, and the park's well-marked, high-traffic trails (Laurel Falls, Grotto Falls) are easy and safe to hike solo.

highlights: Cades Cove scenic loop for wildlife (elk, black bears)
Laurel Falls or Grotto Falls trail
Downtown Knoxville's Market Square
Sunsphere and World's Fair Park
Gatlinburg SkyBridge and SkyLift (touristy but worth it once)
itinerary: Day 1 — Land, walk Market Square and the Old City, dinner at a local brewery.
Day 2 — Drive into the Smokies: Laurel Falls trail in the morning, Cades Cove loop at golden hour for wildlife.
Day 3 — Grotto Falls hike via Trillium Gap Trail, or the Gatlinburg SkyBridge, before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown Knoxville is walkable, but a rental car is essential for the 45-minute drive into the national park and its trailheads.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Knoxville — walkable, with easy highway access to the park via Sevierville or Gatlinburg.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 12 cheapest confirmed date, nonstop JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $177 RT nonstop, and Everglades National Park's Gulf Coast entrance plus the J.N. "Ding" Darling National Wildlife Refuge on Sanibel are both under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown Fort Myers' River District is small and walkable for an evening out, though a rental car is worth it for the barrier islands and refuge.

highlights: J.N. "Ding" Darling NWR wildlife drive and kayak trail
Sanibel Island shelling beaches
Downtown River District murals and riverfront
Edison and Ford Winter Estates
Everglades Gulf Coast boat tour out of Everglades City
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the River District, Edison and Ford Winter Estates, dinner riverfront.
Day 2 — Drive to Sanibel: Ding Darling wildlife drive at low tide, then shell on the beach.
Day 3 — Day trip to Everglades City for a Gulf Coast boat tour before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The River District is walkable; a rental car is essential for Sanibel, the refuge, and the Everglades day trip.
guide.stayArea: Downtown River District — walkable, close to restaurants and a short drive to the causeway.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 10 cheapest confirmed date, nonstop on Southwest or JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $158 RT nonstop, and Enchanted Rock State Natural Area and McKinney Falls State Park bookend a famously solo-friendly food-and-music city.
deals.soloWhy: South Congress and Rainey Street are walkable, counter-seating taco trailers and BBQ joints make solo dining effortless, and live-music bars are built for showing up alone.

highlights: South Congress Avenue shops and Hope Outdoor Gallery
Barton Springs Pool
Lady Bird Lake hike-and-bike trail
Rainey Street live music and food trucks
McKinney Falls State Park's Onion Creek trail
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk South Congress, swim Barton Springs, live music on Rainey Street at night.
Day 2 — Lady Bird Lake trail in the morning, McKinney Falls State Park in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Drive out to Enchanted Rock for a sunrise or sunset climb, back to Austin for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, South Congress, and Rainey Street are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is needed for McKinney Falls and Enchanted Rock.
guide.stayArea: South Congress or Rainey Street — walkable, close to music venues and the lake trail.
food: Franklin Barbecue (arrive early or order ahead)

deals.travelWindow: Late Aug – Sep, cheapest nonstop (Delta); JetBlue nonstop fares run comparable into fall
deals.whyRanked: $192 RT nonstop, and Ohiopyle State Park's whitewater and the Frank Lloyd Wright house Fallingwater are both about 90 minutes southeast.
deals.soloWhy: The Strip District and Downtown are walkable, the Duquesne Incline and bridges make for easy solo sightseeing, and counter-service sandwich shops keep solo meals simple.

highlights: Duquesne Incline and Mount Washington overlook
The Strip District food stalls and markets
Andy Warhol Museum
Point State Park at the Three Rivers confluence
Fallingwater and Ohiopyle State Park day trip
itinerary: Day 1 — Ride the Duquesne Incline for the skyline view, walk Point State Park, dinner in the Strip District.
Day 2 — Andy Warhol Museum in the morning, explore the South Side or Lawrenceville in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Drive to Fallingwater (book a tour ahead) and Ohiopyle State Park for a short hike or raft trip, back for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, the Strip District, and the South Side are walkable and linked by the T light rail and inclines; a rental car is needed for Fallingwater and Ohiopyle.
guide.stayArea: Downtown or the Strip District — walkable, close to the incline and river trails.

deals.travelWindow: Sep – Nov, cheapest nonstop found; JetBlue's current one-way fare floor is $159
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $279 RT nonstop, but Muir Woods and Point Reyes National Seashore are both under an hour away, with Yosemite reachable on a long day trip.
deals.soloWhy: BART runs straight from SFO into downtown, Muni and cable cars cover the walkable neighborhoods, and the city's counter-seating cafes and hostels are used to solo travelers.

highlights: Golden Gate Bridge and Crissy Field
Muir Woods old-growth redwoods
Ferry Building Marketplace
Golden Gate Park and the de Young Museum
Point Reyes' Tomales Point trail
itinerary: Day 1 — BART into the city, walk Crissy Field to the Golden Gate Bridge, dinner at the Ferry Building.
Day 2 — Rent a car for Muir Woods in the morning, Point Reyes Tomales Point trail in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Golden Gate Park and the de Young Museum, or push out to Yosemite for a long day trip before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: BART covers the airport-to-downtown hop and Muni/cable cars handle the neighborhoods; a rental car is needed for Muir Woods, Point Reyes, or Yosemite.
guide.stayArea: Fisherman's Wharf or the Mission — walkable, close to transit and restaurants.
food: Swan Oyster Depot (counter seating, Polk Street)
